items.title: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，主打快速完成编码与 Agent 任务
items.summary: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上以 61 分排第 3，在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 上以 58.6 排第 1，Terminal-Bench 4.1 得分 65.2%。定价为每百万输入 token $3、每百万输出 token $15，上下文窗口为 1 million token，今天起在 Google AI Studio 的 Gemini API 和 Gemini app 等渠道推出。对开发者来说，这是又一个能直接通过 API 接入、面向长时间 Agent 工作流和编码的前沿模型选项。

evidence.quote: Neon ranks ahead of comparable models and #3 overall with a score of 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its xhigh thinking level
The model is priced at $3 per million input tokens ($0.15 per million cached input tokens, a 95% discount) and $15 per million output tokens, with a 1 million-token context window.
ranking #1 overall on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index (58.6), with a score of 65.2% on Terminal-Bench 4.1
Gemini 4 Neon is rolling out today in the Gemini API in Google AI Studio
for Pro and Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app
Engineered for long-running agent workflows

items.title: Anthropic IPO 定价每股 $83.00，今天起在 Nasdaq 交易
items.summary: Anthropic 公布首次公开募股定价：A 类普通股每股 $83.00，共发行 980,000,000 股，股票预计今天在 Nasdaq Global Select Market 以代码 “ANT” 开始交易。Claude 的开发方由此成为上市公司，是今年 AI 行业格局中的一件大事。

evidence.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC priced its initial public offering of its Class A common stock at $83.00 per share. The offering consists of 980,000,000 shares of Class A common stock
The shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on November 19, 2026 under the symbol “ANT.”

items.title: OpenAI 用自家模型改进芯片设计，AMD 已采用部分改动
items.summary: OpenAI 介绍其模型在芯片设计上的成果：在自研推理芯片 Jalapeño 上，模型提出的改动让向量单元的标准单元面积减少约 13%、矩阵单元减少 10%，并已在硅片上验证；与 AMD 合作时，在旗舰 GPU IP 上相对高度优化的基线取得最高 14% 的提升，部分改动已进入 AMD 送去制造的设计。在两个开源 RISC-V 核心的测试中，GPT‑6.2 Astra 平均得分最高。这说明前沿模型已经能在 RTL 层面做专家级的硬件优化，并借助 Synopsys 等 EDA 工具验证结果。

evidence.quote: accelerate the development of our first custom inference chip, Jalapeño

the team estimates that model proposed changes reduced standard-cell area by about 13% in the vector unit and 10% in the matrix unit. These optimizations were silicon proven during Jalapeño’s silicon bring-up
We have partnered with AMD on PPA improvements and seen up to 14% improvement relative to heavily optimized baselines on the flagship GPU IP.
AMD has already included some of these changes in a recent design it sent for manufacturing
we tested each model on two open-source 32-bit RISC-V cores
With a comparable budget of about 112,000 tokens per run, GPT‑6.2 Astra had the highest average score on both cores.
We’ve observed the model reason about RTL at the level of an expert microarchitect.
It used Synopsys tools to verify that each rewrite preserved the block’s behavior

items.title: OpenAI：编码 Agent 已能独立完成近半数两到四小时的研究任务
items.summary: OpenAI 更新了内部研究加速的度量：从三月到十月，在需要人类两到四小时的任务上，Agent 的估计成功率从 23% 升到 46%，四到八小时的任务从 13% 升到 35%；但不同工作差距很大，监控训练任务的自主成功率为 79%，编写推理与服务代码只有 25%。OpenAI 认为提升是“参差不齐”的，人类仍是研究循环的核心。对开发者来说，这是编码 Agent 在真实研发中能做什么、还做不好什么的一手参照。

evidence.quote: From March to October, estimated success rose from 23% to 46% for tasks estimated to require two to four hours of human work, and rose from 13% to 35% for tasks estimated to require four to eight hours.
the autonomous agent success rate was 79% for monitoring training runs, 35% for launching training runs, and 25% for writing code for inference and serving stacks.
Overall, uplift is jagged, and humans remain a core part of the AI research loop.

items.title: Anthropic：Claude Fable 5.2 解决黑洞物理中的两个未解问题
items.summary: Anthropic 介绍 Claude Fable 5.2 解决了理论物理中两个与黑洞和量子引力有关的问题：一是完成了物理学家 20 多年前列出、却从未算完的一项计算，证明相关相变是突变的；二是为一种排除错误理论的方法的最简版本求出精确上限，并证明它无法再降低。第一项计算由 Claude 运行的一个由自身副本组成的小型研究小组完成，几乎每一步都独立推导并对照已知结果检查。这是模型在长链条科学计算中推进前沿研究的一个具体案例。

evidence.quote: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
In the first, it completed a calculation that physicists set up more than 20 years ago, but which had never been solved.

Claude did it by running a small research group of copies of itself, in which it worked out almost every piece of the calculation independently and checked its math against known results. It showed that the phase transition is abrupt.

Claude Fable 5.2 noticed a pattern in the numerical results that physicists had missed and borrowed a method from elsewhere in math and physics to calculate the precise ceiling for the simplest version of this technique and prove that it could not be lowered.

items.title: Google 向 AI Ultra 订阅用户开放世界模型 Genie 4
items.summary: Google 在新版 Project Genie 中向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户推出 Genie 4：探索过程中可以输入新提示实时修改世界，例如换天气、加角色，并首次配上随场景变化的实时原生音频；Genie 3 的单次生成时长也从 60 秒延长到 3 分钟。这是 Genie 4 首次对外开放使用，Google AI Pro 用户目前只能加入候补名单。

evidence.quote: So today, we are rolling out a new Project Genie experience to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers
This update unlocks first-time access to Genie 4
Shift the weather, drop in a character, or redirect the action. For the first time, Genie 4 pairs these visuals with real-time native audio that adapts as the scene unfolds
Explore for up to 3 minutes per generation (up from 60 seconds)
join the waitlist if you are a Google AI Pro member

items.title: RadixArk 发布 DaisyRose-27B：基于 Qwen3.8-27B 做 Agent 强化学习
items.summary: RadixArk 发布首个模型 DaisyRose-27B，在 Qwen3.8-27B 上用开源 RL 框架 Miles 做长程 Agent 任务训练，只用 1,200 个精选任务、在 144 H200 GPUs 上训练 18 天，把 Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 从 5.6% 提到 12.0%。权重以 Apache 2.0 发布，保留了原模型的架构、tokenizer、chat template 和 256K 上下文。对想用少量高质量任务做 Agent 后训练的团队，这是一个有完整配方可参考的开放权重案例。

evidence.quote: built on Qwen3.8-27B and trained with reinforcement learning using Miles
We trained it on long-horizon agent tasks with sessions up to 1M tokens, with just 1,200 curated tasks in 18 days on 144 H200 GPUs. DaisyRose-27B improves Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 from 5.6% to 12.0%
The checkpoints are available under Apache 2.0
The model retains Qwen3.8-27B’s architecture, tokenizer, chat template, image understanding, and 256K-token context window
Miles, our open-source reinforcement learning framework for large-scale model post-training

items.title: Reson8 开源 0.5B 语音识别模型 Rumble-2-Flash，支持 40+ 种语言
items.summary: Reson8 以 Apache 2.0 许可开源 Rumble-2-Flash，这是一个 0.5B 参数、支持 40+ 种语言的语音识别模型，在 Open ASR Leaderboard 多语言榜上平均错误率 6.96%，在 302 小时的呼叫中心基准上 WER 为 7.86%，与 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) 的 7.78% 相当。模型沿用 Qwen3-ASR 架构，可直接在 Transformers 和 vLLM 上运行，不需要 trust_remote_code，适合对成本和速度敏感的多语种转写场景。

evidence.quote: Today we're open sourcing Rumble-2-Flash under the Apache 2.0 license. It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.
On the Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, Rumble-2-Flash averages a 6.96% error rate
on par with NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) on a 302-hour call-centre benchmark
reaches 7.86% WER
Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) at 7.78%
Rumble-2-Flash uses the Qwen3-ASR architecture for day-0 support. If your stack runs Transformers or vLLM, it runs Rumble-2-Flash, with no forked runtime or trust_remote_code

items.title: TeleChat 系列新作 Xing 4：在 Ascend 910C 上训练 Agent 模型
items.summary: Xing 4 技术报告介绍了这一延续 TeleChat 系列的大模型如何针对 Ascend 做架构和训练基础设施设计：基于 MindSpore HyperParallel 的预训练栈支撑在 8,192 张 Ascend 910C 卡上预训练 285B 参数模型，后训练则引入统一的 Agent 执行平台 TeleGym，用异步执行和部分 rollout 处理时长不一的任务。对在国产芯片上做大模型训练的团队，这是一份少见的从架构到系统的工程参考。

items.title: FastFrames 把自回归视频生成做到交互级延迟
items.summary: 论文发现 VAE 解码、KV cache 更新这些常被当作固定开销的环节占了端到端推理延迟的一半以上，换成轻量替代方案后，1.3B 版本在单张 B200 上每帧 36 ms（28 RPS），画质与慢近 8x 的 SOTA 模型相当；14B 版本在 8x B200 节点上每帧 45 ms。它让相机条件、物理条件的视频生成可以实时交互，对做交互式世界模型和游戏的开发者有直接参考价值。

items.title: Multi-Branch Transformer：用并行分支扩展模型，KV cache 最多省 34%
items.summary: 论文提出 Multi-Branch Transformer（MBT），在共享的首尾层之间并行执行多个独立参数的 Transformer 分支，并用 Joint-KV 让同一深度的分支共用一份 KV cache。在 0.8B 到 2.1B 的 MoE 规模上，拟合的 scaling 曲线显示标准 Transformer 需要多达 1.26x 的训练计算才能达到相同验证损失，KV cache 最多减少 34%，单张 H200 上解码吞吐最高提升 51.4%。这为加宽、加深之外的模型扩展提供了第三条路。

evidence.quote: These models reduce full-model KV-cache storage by up to 34% and deliver up to 51.4% higher decoding throughput on a single H200 GPU.

items.title: Energy-Based Reasoners：1.8M 参数在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达 99.9%
items.summary: 论文提出 Energy-Based Reasoners（EBR），让循环推理模型学习潜在推理状态上的能量函数，把每轮循环更新变成对能量的梯度下降：能量值给候选打分，梯度指导改进，并作为何时停止的信号。只有 1.8M 参数的 EBR 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到 99.9% 准确率，推理计算比次优模型少 345×。这为不依赖外部验证器、按难度自适应停止的推理模型提供了一种思路。

evidence.quote: With only 1.8M parameters, EBRs achieve 99.9% accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme while using 345× less inference compute than the next-best model.
Its value scores candidate predictions without requiring an external verifier, while its gradient guides refinement and provides a natural signal for stopping.

items.title: OpenAI 详解 Codex 沙箱：用系统原生机制限制本机命令
items.summary: OpenAI 介绍 Codex 如何在用户现有环境中安全地运行命令：不用虚拟机或容器，而是调用各平台自带的沙箱机制（macOS 上是 Seatbelt），通过权限配置限制文件系统和网络访问；默认的 :workspace 配置允许在工作区内写入、保持 .git 和 .codex 只读，并禁用网络。文中还演示了用 codex sandbox 命令测试权限配置、给 MCP server 加沙箱。自己做 Agent 的开发者可以直接借鉴这套本地沙箱的取舍和实现。

evidence.quote: Instead of moving computation to a separate environment to provide isolation, Codex uses each platform’s sandboxing facilities to constrain commands running in the user’s existing environment.
On macOS, Codex uses Seatbelt
Allows writes within the workspace, while keeping directories such as .git and .codex read-only.
Disables network access.
The Codex CLI provides a sandbox command to facilitate running an arbitrary command under a permission profile defined in the Codex config.
Example: sandboxing an MCP server

items.title: 在 32 GB 的 Mac 上用 Transformers 跑 180B MoE 模型
items.summary: Tarek Ziadé 在 Hugging Face 博客介绍了 Transformers 的 MoE 专家流式加载：只从 SSD 读取路由选中的专家，配合有界缓存，在 32 GB 内存的 MacBook M5 上跑通了 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，解码约 14 tok/s，与专用引擎 Strata 只差约 6%。通用实现已提交为 huggingface/transformers#50717。对想在本地跑超出内存的大 MoE 模型的开发者，这是一个不离开 Transformers 生态的方案。

evidence.quote: Streaming MoE experts directly from SSD gets within 6% of Strata on token generation.
and for work I have a MacBook M5 with 32G of unified memory
Making Qwen3.8-Flash-Next work on my 32 GB Mac with Transformers
It runs at ~14 tok/s, close to Strata
The generic expert streaming implementation is in huggingface/transformers#50717

items.title: Dharma-AI：用 CatBoost 预测微调耗时，比 FLOP 估算准得多
items.summary: Dharma-AI 用生产集群上 272 个 NVIDIA H200 的 SFT 任务（约 7,382 GPU-hours）做对比：常用的 FLOP 估算只有 R² = 0.31、平均绝对误差 12.41 h，只用派发前信息的 CatBoost 回归器则达到 R² = 0.98，平均误差 1.71 h、中位误差 0.51 h。差距来自评估频率、checkpoint 策略、单卡负载这些纯计算公式算不进去的因素。管理共享 GPU 集群的团队可以借鉴这个做法改进排程。

evidence.quote: So we took 272 real supervised fine-tuning (SFT) jobs from our production pool of NVIDIA H200 GPUs, about 7,382 GPU-hours in total

the usual FLOP-based estimate explains little of what we observed (R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41 h). A CatBoost regressor that only sees information available before dispatch reaches R² = 0.98, with a mean absolute error of 1.71 h and a median error of 0.51 h
such as evaluation cadence, checkpoint policy, per-GPU load and fine-tuning regime

items.summary: langchain-openai==1.8.2 加入对 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 的支持，随后的 1.8.3 为 GPT-6.2 启用了 Codex prompt caching。
